messages:
Tara Nguyen: Noticed an odd edge case: redirects to migration anchors are URL-encoding backticks and code-block bullets, which breaks in-page anchors for SDK snippet sections. Example: /docs/migration#node-snippet becomes /docs/migration#node-snippet%60 and anchor not found.
Omar Hassan: Oh yikes. That'll break all quickstarts that link to code blocks. Is this coming from the redirects CSV or the CDN?
Kyle White: Likely both. Infra normalizes paths and then the CDN does an extra encode on fragment during 302->rewrite. I can repro locally with curl -i -L.
Priya Rao: Can we add a test in the redirect smoke checklist to validate anchors after redirect? e.g., fetch final URL and assert 200 and fragment present in body.
Tara Nguyen: Yes please. Also need docs owners to avoid anchors with punctuation in headings. But we can't change all headings. Need reliable redirect encoding rules.
Infra-Bot: Redirect service note: fragments are client-side not sent to server. If we canonicalize old URLs with encoded fragments in mapping, clients may request encoded `%60` if the source link had backtick characters. Recommend normalizing anchors to safe ascii (letters, numbers, hyphen).
Omar Hassan: Short-term fix: update redirects CSV to point old_path -> new_path_without_fragment and include 'fragment_fix' column with post-redirect anchor rewrite instruction for client-side script. Ops can inject a tiny JS shim on the docs site to rewrite decoded anchors.
Kyle White: I can add a small client-side snippet to run on page load that decodes location.hash and tries alternative variations. Example idea:
```js
// try variations of encoded hash
const tryFixHash = () => { const h = decodeURIComponent(location.hash || ''); if (!h) return; const el = document.querySelector(h); if (!el) { const alt = h.replace(/%60/g, ''); const altEl = document.querySelector(alt); if (altEl) location.hash = alt; } };
tryFixHash();
```
Priya Rao: That JS shim sounds good as a bandaid. Add to runbook: must be behind a feature flag and removed after full redirect normalization. Also add a note to inform translators/localizers to avoid characters that map to percent-encoding in anchors.
Tara Nguyen: I'll open a docs PR to normalize problematic headings in high-traffic pages (quickstarts, SDK guides) and add explicit anchor ids where needed. PR will include a checklist mapping old anchors -> new anchors and suggested redirects.
Omar Hassan: Also adding a unit in the redirect CSV: old_path, new_path, owner, fragment_fix. Infra can use fragment_fix to advise client-side shim for specific routes.
Kyle White: I'll add the client-side shim to the docs base in a small PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/720 (draft). It includes tests that simulate encoded/unencoded hash behavior.
Docs-Bot: Reminder: label PRs with 'deprecation' and 'redirects'. Run snippet-lint and smoke tests. :robot_face:
Legal: For the deprecation notice copy, use the approved sentence: "Deprecated endpoints will return HTTP 410 after 2025-06-30; see /docs/migration for migration instructions." Please don't alter legal phrasing.
Priya Rao: Adding a special smoke test: follow 302 chain, then fetch body and assert the expected anchor ID string exists in HTML. If not, fail. We'll gate the docs deploy on this.
Tara Nguyen: I'll bundle a small doc mapping JSON in the PR so infra can ingest it. Also adding owners for each anchor fix.
Omar Hassan: FYI found 8 high-traffic links with backticks in anchors. I'll list them in the issue.
Kyle White: Once the shim is live, we'll monitor 404s for anchors via synthetic checks (weekly) and user reports. Plan to remove shim after 30 days.
Tara Nguyen: Who can add the smoke test? I can, but needs CI time.
Priya Rao: Assigning: smoke test & CI - Tara, client shim - Kyle, redirect CSV format - Omar, anchor edits - Tara + docs reviewers. Schedule #docs-review tomorrow 11am PT to sign off.
Infra-Bot: Deploy note: redirect CSV merge will trigger staging redirect dry-run. Use label 'redirect-dry-run' to avoid production flip.
Docs-Bot: Meeting scheduled: #docs-review tomorrow 11:00 PT. Please tag @Legal for final deprecation copy signoff.
Tara Nguyen: Thanks all. If the anchor shim causes regressions, revert immediately and we'll fall back to removing problematic anchors.
Kyle White: Draft PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/720 (WIP). Comments welcome.
Priya Rao: OK team, let's aim to land all fixes before the public deprecation email. If anything blocks, we'll delay the announcement.
